note: Family-run RV park beside Hwy 2 about five minutes south of Nanton: 45 x 80 ft gravel sites in two long rows, the pull-throughs long enough for a big rig and a towed car; only sites 1 and 39 have 50-amp power. Self-contained rigs only (no tents). No wood fires (propane fire bowls allowed) and no off-road vehicles. Monthly and seasonal sites are sold alongside nightly ones. --Claude
summary: Operator site read (2026 season): C$55 (30 amp) / C$60 (50 amp), any one-night stay C$60, plus GST - under the C$69 gate. Added year-round, 50-amp at two sites, 80-ft sites, no washrooms or showers, dump and water fill, phone booking and the long-weekend 3-night minimum. Stored fees left as they are.
flags: PRICE GATE: passes. 'Cost per night $55.00 for 30 amp service, $60.00 for 50 amp service', 'All 1 night reservations are $60.00 and payable in full when booking and is non-refundable. All prices are subject to GST.' (https://www.jjsrvresort.ca/blank-c1a4e, 2026 site). So one night is C$60 before 5% GST (C$63 with), under C$69. No major park gateway within 40 km (gateways.py: nearest Calgary 86 km, Waterton Lakes NP 140 km).

FEES (stored 55-60, not rewritten): two details to fix in fees.note - GST is extra ('All prices subject to 5% GST'; fees.tax is not set), and the card surcharge is stated two ways on the operator's own pages: '$2/night surcharge' on the rules page, '$3/night surcharge' on the payment-options page. Dogs $2.00 a night each. No extra-person fee is posted.
MINIMUM STAY: 'All Long Weekends Require Minimum 3 Night Booking' - time-of-year only, so it stays; one-night stays are otherwise sold (at the C$60 rate).

SEASONAL SHARE: not stated. The site sells 'Seasonal and Long Term Sites' at $999 (30 amp) / $1099 (50 amp) per 28 days plus GST and describes itself as for 'a quick getaway, an overnight stop, or a comfortable place to call home for a longer stay'; 'Daily and monthly rates'. Esri imagery shows rigs on nearly all of the 40 sites, which cannot tell nightly from monthly. The reviewer may want the share asked by phone.
RIG-AGE RULE: none on the rules page. Other rules: 1 RV and 1 vehicle per site; no children under 18 from Nov 1 to March 31 on monthly stays.

PRESENCE: working operator site with phone 403-585-6574 (confirmed, 'Call Jeremy ... for all bookings'); Google Maps 4.1 stars from 65 reviews, same phone and website. https://www.jjsrvresort.ca answered 200.
WATERFRONT (stored not waterfront - confirmed): a creek channel runs 80-150 m south of the south end of the rows, beyond the owner's yard.
PIN: 50.30620,-113.72320 is at the north end of the two site rows (row centre about 50.3053,-113.7224, 100 m south); no move. Google's point is the house at the south end.
